post.description: Single-row Yes/No summary of currently-held positions on one market, shown as the strip above the Smart Money list. Exposes the same fields as the neg-risk summary (table 37) — current-value dollars (yesValue/noValue), at-risk entry averages (yesPrice/noPrice), wallet counts, the value-share bar (smartPct) and the normalized market marker (marketPct) — so a single strip component renders both. Narrow the wallet set with the User Rank or In Signals filter. Requires exactly one Market filter.

orderBy.description: Sortable keys: yesValue, yesPrice, yesWallets, noValue, noPrice, noWallets, smartPct, marketPct

post.description: Per-wallet net position on one position of a normal (binary, non neg-risk) market — a wallet's Yes and No legs are netted into a single stance on the target position, so wallets netting to the opposite side are excluded. Supersedes Smart Money (table 31), which lists every held leg as its own row. Runtime args $1 = target position id; the market comes as a required filter.

orderBy.description: Sortable keys: userId, netShares, currentValue, entryPrice, unrealizedPnl, unrealizedPnlPercentage

post.description: Single-row Yes/No summary of the cohort's true bets on one market of a neg-risk event. The whole event book of every eligible wallet is canonicalized (net within market, convert No into the rival outcomes, skim the riskless floor — e' = e − min(e), buy cost follows pro-rata) and projected onto the target market. Exposes exactly the strip fields, mirroring the non-neg-risk summary — current-value dollars (yesValue/noValue from yes_value/no_value), at-risk entry averages (yesPrice/noPrice), wallet counts, the value-share bar (smartPct) and the normalized market marker (marketPct). Neg-risk counterpart of Smart Money Summary. Runtime args $1 = event id, $2 = target market id, $3 = signal filter (1/true => only signal legs), $4 = rank filter (0 => no filter), $5 = cohort filter enable (1/true => filter by the runtime cohort $C0).

orderBy.description: Sortable keys: yesValue, yesPrice, yesWallets, noValue, noPrice, noWallets, smartPct, marketPct

post.description: Per-wallet holder rows for one market of a neg-risk event. Each wallet's book is canonicalized (net within market, convert No into rival outcomes with cost split by price, skim the riskless floor — e' = e − min(e)) and emits up to two legs — Side 'yes' (its true bet on the outcome) and Side 'no' (its at-risk money on the rivals, shares in NO-equivalent units). A wallet with genuine opposing bets appears on both sides; hedged pairs and riskless baskets appear on neither. Filter by Side to render the Yes/No holder columns; top 50 legs per side. Neg-risk counterpart of Smart Money. Runtime args $1 = event id, $2 = target market id, $3 = signal filter (1/true => only signal legs), $4 = rank filter (0 => no filter), $5 = cohort filter enable (1/true => filter by the runtime cohort $C0), $6 = value view (1/true => rank legs by current value, for the All cohort; else by at-risk cost).

orderBy.description: Sortable keys: userId, netShares, currentValue, entryPrice, unrealizedPnl, unrealizedPnlPercentage, side, atRisk

post.description: Markets ranked by Edge — how far the selected wallets' dollar-weighted implied Yes probability sits above the live Yes price (always in the Yes frame; positive = smart money more bullish on Yes than the market). One row per active, liquid, non-neg-risk market, with the dominant side badge (side + its smart-money price vs market price), At Risk (total held USD), market liquidity, distinct wallets, and days left. Narrow the wallet set with the User Rank, In Signals, or cohort (Wallet) filter — all applied per wallet, before the per-market aggregation.

orderBy.description: Sortable keys: marketId, side, isYes, smartMoneyPrice, marketPrice, yesSlippage, atRisk, liquidity, wallets, daysLeft, tagIds
